name: Lake Cast
summary: A mountain lake fishing game: cast from an old jetty, strike when the float dives and play the fish in
about: A full-screen lake at first light, with snowy peaks mirrored in the water, drifting mist, reeds, lily pads, passing birds and fish shadows that leap now and then. You aim, hold to cast and let go in the green for a perfect throw, wait out the nibbles, strike when the float goes under, then reel in short pulls while a tension meter warns you before the line snaps. Five fishing spells from first light to moonrise each ask for a heavier catch before the clock runs out.
how: A demo angler fishes on load; press Take the rod, Start fishing, Space or tap the water to take over.
Aim with the mouse, the arrow keys or WASD; hold Space, the big button or a finger on the water and let go in the green band to cast.
Small dips are nibbles; press when the float dives right under to hook the fish, or tap while waiting to twitch the bait.
Hold to reel and let go when the bar turns red or the fish runs; a slack line lets it escape and a snapped line costs a float.
Land the target weight before the clock ends to clear the level; C reels in, P or Escape pauses and R restarts.
Your best score is saved on this device and reduced motion calms the reeds, jumps and splashes.
